New Release 🆕

She Broke My Bones, I Took Her Domain
She Broke My Bones, I Took Her DomainModernSent to New York for an arranged engagement, Marco De Luca is blindsided by betrayal when Isabella turns on him and Nico leaves him severely injured. As his father comes with the De Luca forces seeking revenge, Marco answers by seizing the Moretti family’s crucial East Coast docks.
She Broke My Bones, I Took Her Domain
I Paid $30 Billion for the Wrong Brother
I Paid $30 Billion for the Wrong BrotherModernShe paid billions for love, only to be humiliated when Lorenzo Moretti abandoned her at the altar and ran to Bianca. Reborn on the very day of the wedding, Elena Rossi chooses a different path. This time, when Lorenzo disappears again, she claims Dante Moretti—his commanding adopted uncle and the real father of her baby—by her side. While Lorenzo loses his fortune and status and destroys himself chasing Bianca, Elena reclaims everything he took from her and builds a peaceful future with Dante.
I Paid $30 Billion for the Wrong Brother
I Gave My Daughter a Black Card. She Was Dumpster Diving.
I Gave My Daughter a Black Card. She Was Dumpster Diving.ModernAn unlimited black card should have protected Ivy’s daughter, but instead she was forced to dumpster dive, beaten, and abandoned. Once Queen Victoria uncovers how a fake princess and her lover stole Ivy’s inheritance and abused her, she strikes back without mercy. Anyone who hurts a queen’s daughter will pay dearly.
I Gave My Daughter a Black Card. She Was Dumpster Diving.
The Bully's Worst Nightmare: My 108 Mafia Moms
The Bully's Worst Nightmare: My 108 Mafia MomsModernTaken in after being abandoned as a baby, Ryan Moretti grows up with 108 women he assumes are struggling, low-ranking mobsters. At school, a wealthy bully forces him into a brutal humiliation, and Ryan hides the pain so his moms won’t get dragged into it. Yet once they learn the truth, the entire Moretti family shows up at the school—and Ryan is stunned to discover just how powerful his so-called poor mothers really are.
The Bully's Worst Nightmare: My 108 Mafia Moms
Rejected by My Ex,Claimed by the Mafia Queen
Rejected by My Ex,Claimed by the Mafia QueenModernChloe once left me at City Hall, convinced I’d wait forever while she married someone else. Instead, I vanished overseas, accepted my family’s plan, and started over in a life she never saw coming. Three years later, I return with my daughter, and my wife is carrying our second child. Chloe mistakes my return for desperation, humiliates me in front of everyone, and treats me like a loser. Then the feared woman arrives, and the truth about me is finally about to come out.
Rejected by My Ex,Claimed by the Mafia Queen
The Heiress Returns to Rule
The Heiress Returns to RuleModernTaken in as the beloved princess of a mafia dynasty, Blair comes back to her billionaire birth family expecting answers, not mercy. Instead, she faces prejudice, favoritism, and a cunning fake heiress trying to hold her place. Blair won’t beg to belong. Armed with fearless confidence and her parents’ support, she’s set on uncovering the truth and overturning the family’s rules on her own terms.
The Heiress Returns to Rule
The Plus-Size Daughter They Forgot
The Plus-Size Daughter They ForgotModernShe grew up caught between two families, yet neither ever truly made room for her. Her younger sister was welcomed everywhere, while she remained the one forgotten. Then, on the very day she leaves for college, she is cast aside again—until she chooses to leave the family that never chose her. Alone, she sets out to build a home and a future of her own.
The Plus-Size Daughter They Forgot
They Messed with the Captain’s Daughter
They Messed with the Captain’s DaughterModernTo everyone at Westbrook Academy, Ethan looked like nothing more than a shabby mechanic. They had no idea he was once the feared commander of the Howling Commandos. After losing his wife, he traded his uniform for a quiet life with Emma, trying to leave war behind. But when the rich kids turn on his daughter, and their powerful families cover for them, the peace he built starts to collapse. Once Emma is abducted, Ethan goes after her alone, crashing their gala and sending shockwaves through the Four Houses. And when Kane’s assassins close in, the man who walked away from war returns as the nightmare no enemy can forget.
They Messed with the Captain’s Daughter
My wife had an affair with her late sister's husband.
My wife had an affair with her late sister's husband.ModernIris takes her twin sister’s place after a tragic sacrifice, but the identity she hides comes with a secret she can’t confess to Silas. Sure his love will hold, she misses the warning signs as he readies himself to leave forever. When everything falls apart, will there be anything left to salvage?
My wife had an affair with her late sister's husband.
He Took Me for Granted, Until I Took It All Back
He Took Me for Granted, Until I Took It All BackModernBehind Adrian’s success was Serena, secretly supporting him for seven long years. When his mistress cuts her hair and sells demeaning photos, Adrian doesn’t defend Serena—he takes the mistress’s side. Devastated, Serena cuts off the money and prepares to strike back. At an extravagant gala, her real identity is exposed. Will Adrian lose everything in one night?
He Took Me for Granted, Until I Took It All Back
Dragon King on Dung Duty!
Dragon King on Dung Duty!High FantasyHumiliated on a noble dragon ranch, Kyle and his mother survive as slaves until her injury drives him into the Royal Dragon Knight trials. There, Kyle's black scales are exposed and he is branded an evil dragon. But the awakening Dragon King's mark reveals a far greater truth: his real bloodline and High Priest Byron's scheme. Kyle transforms into a golden dragon, defeats the evil Dragon King, clears his name, punishes the cruel nobles, and takes the throne as the new Dragon King.
Dragon King on Dung Duty!
Mirror,Mirror：The Evil Queen Steals the Show
Mirror,Mirror：The Evil Queen Steals the ShowModernSent into Aurora’s body after failing to poison Snow White, the evil queen wakes up as an overweight schoolgirl with serious fashion talent. Noah, the campus crush and her oldest friend, likes her—but won’t admit it openly because of how she looks. Then Delucia, Snow White’s double, keeps framing Aurora and trying to steal Noah. This time, the queen strikes back. She bets that in 100 days she’ll transform enough to walk a fashion competition stage in her own design. The result? A jaw-dropping glow-up that turns heads and lands her on a top label’s radar.
Mirror,Mirror：The Evil Queen Steals the Show
Dragon Emperor Returns
Dragon Emperor ReturnsHigh FantasyRejected by the royals for an unworthy bloodline, Kain was raised by priests and forged himself through harsh training. He entered Dragon Academy searching for the past that was stolen from him—and stunned everyone by dropping a three-headed dragon with a single blow. His mother recognized the birthmark at once, yet his father accused him of theft and sent him to die. When the emperor moved to strike, the general spotted the platinum insignia on Kain's blade and yelled for him to stop. No one realized Kain had already awakened the Pureblood. Platinum fire blazed, his family knelt, and Kain rose.
Dragon Emperor Returns
The Witch in Mom’s Dress
The Witch in Mom’s DressModernFor 300 years, Mara is trapped in a graveyard with only Clara as a friend—until Clara is murdered by her abusive husband. Taking Clara’s appearance, Mara leaves the graveyard, raises Lily and Toby, kills their violent father, and learns what it means to be a mother. She soon becomes a fierce shield for other abused women in the village. When resentful men lure her into an exorcist’s trap, the women stand beside her, claiming the name of witches until she is freed. Later, Mara watches Lily marry Leo and meets her granddaughter.
The Witch in Mom’s Dress
False Prince, True Thunder Heir
False Prince, True Thunder HeirHigh FantasyAiden was born the true prince, blessed by Thor from his first breath—then stolen from his fate by Martha’s betrayal. Raised as a slave while Lucas takes his place and thunder birthright, he survives cruelty until the God-Blood Duel changes everything. With his thunder power fully awakened, Aiden brings down Lucas and Roland, the sea-god heir, and protects Valen’s border. Once the queen’s seal exposes who he really is, he doesn’t chase revenge. He makes every wrongdoer answer, frees the slaves, and fights for justice.
False Prince, True Thunder Heir
The Lower-City Outcast Was the Mech God All Along
The Lower-City Outcast Was the Mech God All AlongReversal of FortuneBeneath a bug-ravaged world, the upper city controls energy and mecha might, leaving the lower city to scrape by. Kyle, written off as a nobody, shocks everyone by defeating a royal-class bug on his own and becomes the hidden legend the Alliance wants. His search for his past leads him upward, where he is mocked and dismissed as a false heir. Then danger strikes Mona during the mecha tournament, and Kyle stops holding back. In one moment, the city learns that its "trash" is actually the true Cross heir—and history's most powerful mecha pilot.
The Lower-City Outcast Was the Mech God All Along
I Married the Vampire King After They Betrayed Me
I Married the Vampire King After They Betrayed MeFantasySaintess Selene Moretti carries the rarest healing blood. After saving Lord Sanguini, she is raised with his five sons, and when a curse makes them beasts, her sight alone brings them back. But the demon warned them: betray the vow, and the blindness—and their cruelty—will return. Morgana, a half-vampire, enters their world, and everything collapses. Selene hears the five mock her, regains her sight, and is left to endure Morgana’s humiliation and feeding. By the eclipse, deception turns the brothers into beasts once more. Selene’s answer? She pledges herself to the 500-year-old Lucien Nott—never powerless, only done saving those who failed her.
I Married the Vampire King After They Betrayed Me
The Dragon Tyrant’s Seventh Bride
The Dragon Tyrant’s Seventh BrideHigh FantasyEveryone called Elena a bad omen, while Roxanna was worshiped as the Moon Goddess’s reincarnation. In their previous life, Roxanna’s marriage to the Black Dragon Tyrant ended in tragedy; Elena’s union with a humble Green Dragon led to the birth of a pure Divine Dragon. Reborn and consumed by spite, Roxanna swaps their contracts to make Elena suffer her doomed destiny. What she doesn’t know: only Elena can break the tyrant’s deadly curse, because Elena is the real Moon Goddess. And whoever wins her hand will rise as the Dragon King.
The Dragon Tyrant’s Seventh Bride
Framed: Return of the Invincible
Framed: Return of the InvincibleHigh FantasyEd Tally was born in the slums, and even the potion bought with his father's blood is nearly stolen from his fate when Freya spills it. But one taste of what remains awakens the SSS-grade Phoenix Flame. After Otho frames him and Dean Seran forces him to kneel in humiliation, Ed has only one path forward. Beside ability user Laila, he hunts monsters to save his mother and masters the power to absorb their instincts. From the forest to the selection arena, he fights his way up, crushes Otho before everyone, exposes Seran's abuse, wins royal recognition, and clears his family's honor.
Framed: Return of the Invincible
Swapped Bride of Beast Realm：I Reject My First Love
Swapped Bride of Beast Realm：I Reject My First LoveFantasyLyla once loved Kyle without question, only to be betrayed and destroyed. Reborn as the Fox clan’s eldest daughter with her memories intact, she makes a different choice: marrying Lucien, the snake prince. What begins as a move for survival deepens into love as they face danger together, expose both families’ conspiracies, and claim the throne of the beast clans.
Swapped Bride of Beast Realm：I Reject My First Love
BLOOD FOR BLOOD: A Father's Revenge
BLOOD FOR BLOOD: A Father's RevengeModernEthan Matthew, a White Eagle Medal holder known as the god of war, comes back after ten years to see his mother and daughter. After stopping a bank robbery, he draws FBI agent Claire’s attention—only to face a far crueler reality when he finds his daughter’s grave instead of her. Determined to make those responsible answer, Ethan goes after Lane Moretti and uncovers the Lawrence family behind it all. Teaming up with Claire, he pushes forward until he reaches the ruthless Wayne Lawrence. For Ethan, justice leaves no room for mercy.
BLOOD FOR BLOOD: A Father's Revenge
Reborn Before My Best Friend Betrayed Me
Reborn Before My Best Friend Betrayed MeFutureFive years before her downfall, a betrayed Class-N candidate gets one chance to rewrite the night that ruined her. Mara may have set the trap, but with Ethan by her side and the truth already in hand, she’s ready to expose the setup, recover her commission, and unravel the supply chain behind it all.
Reborn Before My Best Friend Betrayed Me
Regrets Of A Fallen Mafia Queen
Regrets Of A Fallen Mafia Queen ModernFor Seraphina, I gave up everything—the career, the city, the future I had planned—and poured three years into the life we were meant to share. It all shattered when she skipped our engagement party for a boy pretending a routine appendectomy was a crisis. Once I uncovered his vicious game, I resigned in silence and vanished into Black Bay’s unforgiving slums. I thought distance would kill what I still felt for her, until she came after me across the world, burdened with regret and refusing to let me disappear from her life.
Regrets Of A Fallen Mafia Queen
No Place For Me In Their Glory
No Place For Me In Their GloryModernNovia’s graduation day turns into a betrayal she never saw coming: her boyfriend and friends deceive her into shaving her hair, steal her thesis, and trap her while fighting an asthma attack—all to snatch her BCI program opportunity. Devastated, she leaves it all behind to join classified research with her ailing mother. Five years later, success is finally hers, and the same faces from her past want reconciliation. After everything they destroyed, can old wounds really heal?
No Place For Me In Their Glory
The Hacker They Mocked Was the Legend They Needed
The Hacker They Mocked Was the Legend They NeededModernEveryone writes Mira Vance off as a useless hacker—until she enters an underground cyber tournament in the middle of Kessler and Varga’s showdown. Betrayed from within and targeted by rivals, she must fight through a deadly virtual battlefield, expose Lena’s schemes, and show she’s the only one who can protect her team.
The Hacker They Mocked Was the Legend They Needed
The Warlord’s Baby Chose Me
The Warlord’s Baby Chose MeFutureNora Bellamy, a rabbit maid trapped inside the Serpent Warlord’s estate, never expects a voice from an unborn baby to turn her life upside down. Gifted with divine lineage and remarkable luck, Felix pulls her toward Lucian Blackthorne and the danger surrounding him. Standing in her way is Vanessa, Lucian’s ruthless mate, who will stop at nothing to take his power and erase her rival. As a cheeky child’s guidance leads her forward, Nora navigates betrayal, unexpected love, and a chance to claim the family meant for her.
The Warlord’s Baby Chose Me
Oops! I Had the Billionaire’s Baby
Oops! I Had the Billionaire’s BabyModernClaire escaped heartbreak five years ago, never telling Adrian Walker that the son she was raising was his. Now she’s back in New York, where the billionaire heir—and her brother’s best friend—still hasn’t given up on finding her. Once Leo’s resemblance to Adrian becomes impossible to ignore, Claire’s secret starts falling apart. Then Leo takes matters into his own hands, giving his newfound father just one month to prove himself. Can this broken story turn into a real family?
Oops! I Had the Billionaire’s Baby
Married the Richest Homeless Man
Married the Richest Homeless ManModernMiles Ward lives in disguise, hiding his place as the heir to the city’s richest family behind the life of a homeless man. When Margot Hayes weds him just to spite the ex who betrayed her, she steps into a battle she can’t see. As Preston targets her business, Miles quietly flips every move against him. The biggest secret of all? Margot has no idea the man beside her is both a billionaire and the stranger who once rescued her.
Married the Richest Homeless Man
The XXL Bride's Return
The XXL Bride's ReturnAncientDamian ruins Anna’s wedding day by tampering with her dress until it splits apart and sends her into the mud. Down in the slums, Alex offers no pity—only a rope, a stone lock, and a choice: make three laps or leave. She spends three months forging a new self. When she comes back as Selene, a rich widow, Damian never sees her coming until his fortune is gone. Before the tribunal, she tears away her veil: “I am that fat bride.” She walks off, and Alex meets her with water. “I feel no relief,” she says. “Then leave him behind,” he tells her, as they walk toward Subura.
The XXL Bride's Return
Saved the Baby，Claimed the Billionaire
Saved the Baby，Claimed the Billionaire ModernElena Shawn has a secret: she can hear babies’ thoughts. On her first day as a nurse, that gift tells her billionaire Alex Reed’s nephew, Noah, is not beyond help. His refusal to drink milk isn’t a tantrum—it points to a hidden scheme involving Alex’s fiancée. While Elena helps Noah heal, she becomes his favorite caregiver and wins Alex’s admiration. With one mischievous baby nudging them together, will Elena and Alex find a way to turn trust into family?
Saved the Baby，Claimed the Billionaire
My Fiancé Was a Robot My Ex Built To Test Me
My Fiancé Was a Robot My Ex Built To Test MeFutureHer dream engagement shatters when Silla finds out her fiancé is an android designed in secret by her billionaire ex. Mocked as a gold digger, she refuses to stay in their cruel game and takes a one-way post on a faraway planet. By the time they realize her love was real and never about money, she may already be beyond reach.
My Fiancé Was a Robot My Ex Built To Test Me
The Mafia Queen's Guard Dog Answers Only To Me
The Mafia Queen's Guard Dog Answers Only To MeModernAiden has a rare gift: he can understand animals. Working as a cleaner for Mafia Queen Victoria, he rescues her treasured hound Apollo from a deadly misdiagnosis. Soon Apollo is playing cupid as Aiden and Victoria expose a poisoning plot, outwit their foe, and discover love in a dangerous world.
The Mafia Queen's Guard Dog Answers Only To Me
Mom, Dad, Did I Pass Your Test?
Mom, Dad, Did I Pass Your Test?ModernI finally found my billionaire family, only for them to fake losing it all. Believing I had to prove I was worthy, I worked four jobs to cover my sister’s pretend terminal illness. After three years, I collapsed and died alone, as they laughed outside my door, certain their twisted test had made me worthy of being family.
Mom, Dad, Did I Pass Your Test?
Mind-Read At the Grave: Grandma's Bloodbath
Mind-Read At the Grave: Grandma's BloodbathModernEvelyn Vale returns from a hard-won mafia war expecting peace, only to walk into her daughter’s funeral. But the silent girl at the center of it all carries a truth no one dares speak: Evelyn’s daughter isn’t dead, the corpse is a decoy, and the little girl is her real granddaughter. Furious, Evelyn shuts down the burial and begins a relentless search for the people behind the scheme.
Mind-Read At the Grave: Grandma's Bloodbath
My Master Is a Dragon
My Master Is a DragonSupernaturalSophie has nothing on Earth—then she’s suddenly swept into an alien paradise where humans are rare and sought-after mates. Gideon, a powerful horned dragon warrior, becomes intensely drawn to her. Shaken by his steady obsession and a bond she can’t escape, Sophie faces one impossible question: give in to this dazzling new world, or fight for a happy ending on her own terms.
My Master Is a Dragon
Crown of Vengeance
Crown of VengeanceAncientIn 1740s Valdoria, Celeste Ashford grows up with revenge in her heart after her mother is murdered by Eleanor Blackwood. Raised and sharpened by Lady Marguerite Valois, the king’s mistress, she enters the royal court a decade later to confront the woman who has become queen. As Celeste gains the king’s attention, danger closes in through poison, blame, and a fake pregnancy scandal. Even as doubt and betrayal test them, her connection to Marguerite remains unbroken—right up to her mentor’s final sacrifice.
Crown of Vengeance
Sword drawn, I'm Dragon slayer
Sword drawn, I'm Dragon slayerReversal of FortuneSable was born under the curse of Twin Moon Blood, and her father keeps her from claiming the Sword in the Stone. When the dragon Shivana awakens, Sable finds a new path—training beside exiled prince Lawrence, reforging Frostbite, and discovering that a dragon princess once sacrificed herself to contain the Dragon King. As Sable and Shivana become allies, they bring down the Dragon King and restore the seal. After the battle, Sable builds a school for orphans, giving dragon-slayers a new purpose as protectors.
Sword drawn, I'm Dragon slayer
Betrayed by Three Fiancées, the XXL Heir Married an Imperial General
Betrayed by Three Fiancées, the XXL Heir Married an Imperial GeneralLove After MarriageHe saved his three fiancées from the Dark Tide, then lost everything. Ethan Vale is left with a broken magic core and a transformed body, while those he protected believe the lie, take away his place at the academy, and abandon him when he needs help most. Imperial General Victoria Kane becomes his unexpected lifeline, and their marriage pact offers a chance to heal. As trouble returns to the border, Ethan faces one question: who can he trust this time?
Betrayed by Three Fiancées, the XXL Heir Married an Imperial General
I Built His Billion-Dollar Empire. He Paid Me $30K to Leave.
I Built His Billion-Dollar Empire. He Paid Me $30K to Leave.ModernHe humiliated me at his IPO party, slapped me, and divorced me for his secretary. But while he was chasing success, I was the one who had secretly poured $80 million into his company and handed over my seven patents for free. I signed the divorce papers, went back to my billionaire family, and took away the one thing he could never afford to lose.
I Built His Billion-Dollar Empire. He Paid Me $30K to Leave.
I Fell for My Boss's Fiancée Online
I Fell for My Boss's Fiancée OnlineModernTo pay for his grandmother’s medical care, Oliver works as personal assistant to Don Justin. Then Justin gives him an impossible task: pretend to be him while messaging Kiara Sanders, the wealthy fiancée chosen for an arranged marriage. For months, Kiara falls for the man in the texts—never knowing those tender words come from Oliver. But after a slip from his own phone nearly breaks the cover, Kiara comes home ready to discuss the engagement. Can Oliver keep the deception from unraveling?
I Fell for My Boss's Fiancée Online
Dumped for My Size, Loved by His Best Friend
Dumped for My Size, Loved by His Best FriendModernPublicly, she was never good enough. Privately, she was good enough to hide. Liana transforms herself for the boy she’s loved since childhood, only to find him with someone else at a Christmas party. Ashamed and trapped in a fish costume, she’s ready to slip away when his best friend claims the role of boyfriend for the night—right before his eyes. Not as a favor, but because he’s wanted Liana from the very beginning.
Dumped for My Size, Loved by His Best Friend
They Built A Family In the Wasteland, So I Smashed the Gate
They Built A Family In the Wasteland, So I Smashed the GateFutureWhen Nora’s husband and son find a portal leading to a ruined future, they use it to start a new family with his pregnant mistress. They steal her money, leave her alone through a miscarriage, and even force her to bleed for the other woman. Betrayed by the people closest to her, Nora finally reaches her breaking point. One blow of a sledgehammer destroys the portal forever, leaving her husband and son to face the debts and devastation they created while Nora takes back her life.
They Built A Family In the Wasteland, So I Smashed the Gate
Escaping Our R18 Mafia men with My Bestie
Escaping Our R18 Mafia men with My BestieTime TravelNora and Vivian refuse to stay trapped in a comic-book fate. Marked for tragic villain endings as the love interests of two powerful men, they fake their deaths and flee with money in hand. When their former lovers catch up to them, secrets surface, danger closes in, and both women fight for relationships they choose for themselves.
Escaping Our R18 Mafia men with My Bestie
My Life As A Human Pet On An Alien Planet
My Life As A Human Pet On An Alien PlanetFutureMarcus is 25, broke, jobless, and having the worst day of his life—right up until aliens abduct him and he opens his eyes inside a pet shop. On a planet where humans are rare and valuable, he’s purchased for ten times his price by Vivian, a masked warrior so feared no one dares cross her. But instead of treating him like property, she protects him like a treasure. And when Marcus realizes she wanted more than just a pet, everything about his strange new world changes.
My Life As A Human Pet On An Alien Planet
Roses, Regret, and Forever Goodbye
Roses, Regret, and Forever GoodbyeModernThey erased me once—my ex-husband locked me in a psychiatric hospital, and my brother declared me dead, all for Audrey. Eight years later, they find me behind the counter of my bakery, buying desserts for his pregnant wife. They came expecting tears. I give them change. But when my little sister appears, everything shifts. His voice shakes: “Is she our daughter?” I look him straight in the eye. “After what you did to me, I can’t have children.” They want absolution now. Too bad they haven’t heard the worst yet.
Roses, Regret, and Forever Goodbye
They Mocked the XXL Heiress,She Was the Masked Demon.
They Mocked the XXL Heiress,She Was the Masked Demon.ModernRuby Vance came back after six missing years looking harmless: a fragile daughter with a sweet tooth for strawberries and strawberry cake. Her family has no idea she was once “The Wall,” a ten-time champion in the ring. When eight rival clubs tear through the family gym and put down her father and brothers, they laugh and treat Ruby like dead weight. Big mistake. She’s never been weak—only lazy. Now she’s putting the gloves on for the people she loves.
They Mocked the XXL Heiress,She Was the Masked Demon.
Wedding Off. Game On.
Wedding Off. Game On.ModernDylan Whitaker, a retired F1 world champion, flies to Austin expecting to meet his arranged fiancée, racing CEO Madison Sterling. Instead, she brands him a loser and chooses the reserve driver who assaults him and leaves his championship car damaged. Dylan walks away from the wedding, takes control of the race, and forces everyone to see who he really is—a legend on the track and the investor Madison’s struggling team desperately needs. Five laps decide the outcome, but the price of their mistake will be much higher.
Wedding Off. Game On.
The Extra Daughter Fights Back
The Extra Daughter Fights BackModernMom’s remarriage left me as the odd one out. The final blow came with a family photo labeled, “The four of us are enough.” So I left for boarding school, three hundred miles from home. Now she’s asking me to return—but does she want her daughter back, or just her perfect-family image restored?
The Extra Daughter Fights Back
My Wedding, My Epitaph
My Wedding, My EpitaphModernMy wedding turned into my betrayal when my fiancé and my own brother chose someone else over me. To teach me a lesson, they pushed me out—never imagining they might lose me for good. Then everything changed: my fiancé saw his mistake, and the orphan he kept protecting exposed her true nature. Now the men who hurt me want me back. After they threw me away for a liar, can they really expect forgiveness?
My Wedding, My Epitaph

Most Popular 🔥

Oops! My Online Ex Is The Mafia Don
Oops! My Online Ex Is The Mafia DonModernNicole starts an online deception as Luna, winning over Mafia don William until she suddenly cuts off contact before their meeting. During spring break at her best friend Sofia’s home, she makes a shocking discovery: William is Sofia’s elder brother. Trapped between the lie she told and the feelings she can’t control, Nicole must stay hidden while every encounter with William brings the risk of exposure.
Oops! My Online Ex Is The Mafia Don
The Night I Took My Warmth Away
The Night I Took My Warmth AwayModernFor ten years, Maeve has been the one constant in Rafe Conti’s life—his living pillow, his late-night comfort, the woman who sent every other love away. He never valued the quiet devotion she gave him, only expected her to stay. But when the contract finally ends, Maeve chooses herself. She walks out with her future in hand, leaving Rafe behind with an empty bed, unanswered calls, and the first real taste of what it means to lose her.
The Night I Took My Warmth Away
THE DON'S CRAZY SUPERHERO BRIDE
THE DON'S CRAZY SUPERHERO BRIDEModernGia Romano has spent three years in a psychiatric hospital, yet she still believes she’s Captain Meteor, a superhero held captive by villains. Everything shifts when Dante Moretti, a mafia don, takes her in and proposes a contract marriage. While looking after Leo and Nina, Gia’s wild humor and keen instincts start pulling apart the secrets inside the Moretti Family. In helping Dante face betrayal, she finds that their arrangement is no longer just business—and that self-trust may be the key to her freedom.
THE DON'S CRAZY SUPERHERO BRIDE
Second Chance With My Ruthless Don
Second Chance With My Ruthless DonModernElara dies with betrayal on her lips and wakes seven days into a marriage to Alex Moretti, the feared Mafia Don she once misunderstood. In her first life, Ethan betrayed her for profit, used her as bait, and brought them both to ruin. This time, she refuses the same ending: she will win Alex’s trust, expose the family behind her stolen inheritance and missing memories, and protect the man who gave everything for her. With every secret uncovered, the coldest marriage becomes the deepest love.
Second Chance With My Ruthless Don
Oops! My Dumped Online Lover Is The Mafia
Oops! My Dumped Online Lover Is The MafiaModernOnline, Ethan hides behind the name Leo and starts a romance that he never expects to turn real. The woman on the other side is Victoria—his friend’s Mafia-don sister. Shocked by the truth, he blocks her and tries to walk away, only to meet her again in person. Soon Victoria starts piecing together the clues in his voice and behavior. Under growing pressure and tense tests, Ethan moves toward confession, and the two are drawn closer despite the danger around them.
Oops! My Dumped Online Lover Is The Mafia
Princess by Day, Ten-Time Champion by Night
Princess by Day, Ten-Time Champion by NightModernOnline, I’m dismissed as the pampered daughter of a legendary boxing family, good for nothing more than laughs. Offscreen, I’ve spent ten years surviving the underground ring as the undefeated Masked Reaper. But after eight rival gyms invade our home, injure my father and brothers, and drag the Callahan name through the mud live, I can’t stay hidden anymore. They meant to break us—they ended up bringing my true self back to the surface.
Princess by Day, Ten-Time Champion by Night

But when an elder pins Adrian's death on her and demands a marriage alliance, Evelyn refuses to be controlled. Standing with Marcus, she exposes the conspiracy and claims the Vale family leadership for herself.
After Losing My Baby, I Returned as the Mafia’s Beloved Heiress
Reborn: You Chose Your Dream Girl, I Married a Billionaire
Reborn: You Chose Your Dream Girl, I Married a BillionaireModernOlivia once died on the road to divorce. Reborn, she chooses silence over revenge, clearing the way for her ex to chase the woman he loves and vanishing from his life. Seven years later, he humiliates her in front of everyone, sure she can still be broken without him. Then a little boy calls her Mommy, and a feared billionaire arrives looking for his wife, exposing the secret life she’s kept hidden. But the deepest shock comes when her ex’s son is dying and only one mysterious surgeon can save him—who will he have to beg?
Reborn: You Chose Your Dream Girl, I Married a Billionaire
I Loved the Mafia Don Until I Forgot Him
I Loved the Mafia Don Until I Forgot HimModernMy Mafia husband gave my Best Actress award to his mistress—my own half sister. Now he believes my illness has erased every memory of him. The most powerful Don in New York is begging me to remember our marriage, while my first love, the doctor he accused me of cheating with, helps me start over. He can threaten, bribe, and promise me the world, but he can’t make me love him again. There’s one thing he’ll never know: I remember every betrayal. This is the performance of my life.
I Loved the Mafia Don Until I Forgot Him
A Toddler Crashed the Don’s Deal for Milk Money
A Toddler Crashed the Don’s Deal for Milk MoneyModernRosie is only 3.5 years old, but she walks straight into a Bellini mafia meeting and demands Dante pay back three years of formula money. Laughed off as a liar, she proves who she is with his old wound and a family keepsake. Just when false records begin to ruin her late mother’s name, a recorder hidden in her rabbit brings the frame-up to light.
A Toddler Crashed the Don’s Deal for Milk Money
Done Being a Lady. Time to Shoot.
Done Being a Lady. Time to Shoot.ModernOn what should have been Rosa Moretti’s happiest day, a gunshot turns the celebration into chaos, leaving the Reaper betrayed, injured, and driven out of Greyport. Trapped behind enemy lines with no support and nowhere to turn, she arrives in a strange place in a ruined wedding dress and risks everything she has left. A formidable Godmother is willing to give her an army—but the price may be worse than revenge itself. Who betrayed Rosa, and is Cole really against her?
Done Being a Lady. Time to Shoot.
The Night I Went Into Labor, My Husband Abandoned Me
The Night I Went Into Labor, My Husband Abandoned MeModernNine months pregnant and cut off from the world, Chloe is locked away by Richard when he takes her hospital bag for his childhood friend. With no power, no water, and no escape, she loses her baby and is presumed dead. Yet Chloe comes back hidden behind a new face, determined to see them all behind bars.
The Night I Went Into Labor, My Husband Abandoned Me
Swapped at the Altar
Swapped at the AltarModernUsed and overlooked, Sophia DeLuca had her name, her gifts, and even her fiancé stolen by her sister Sofia. Then a swapped marriage contract changes everything, binding her to Gabriel, the forgotten Romano son. Everyone dismisses him as a poor trade—until his true identity is revealed: heir to the formidable Moretti family. While Sofia and Marco move to take him back, Gabriel shields Sophia, turns against the betrayal, and finally places her future in her own hands.
Swapped at the Altar
I Sold My Love, Now They Beg For It
I Sold My Love, Now They Beg For ItModernChloe was betrayed by the people who should have loved her most, so she makes a painful deal at the Soul Shop and leaves for boarding school to build a life of her own. By the time her family realizes her worth, she’s already moving forward. And with James beside her, Chloe begins to recover the trust and sense of belonging she thought she had given up for good.
I Sold My Love, Now They Beg For It
My Boyfriend’s Brother Wants Me
My Boyfriend’s Brother Wants MeModernHe won’t stop tempting me, yet he still says I’m not his type. Then I catch my boyfriend cheating, and revenge leads me straight to his brother’s doorstep. As I stand there with the truth I’ve been holding back, the next move could bind us together—or ruin everything.
My Boyfriend’s Brother Wants Me
The Wrong Boyfriend, the Right Husband
The Wrong Boyfriend, the Right HusbandModernBlinded in a crash, Audrey leans on Jared as the one person she believes will never fail her. Yet the man by her side is only a mask: five impostors have taken turns acting as him while the real Jared drains her family’s power and lives a hidden life with someone else. Audrey has quietly regained her sight six months ago, and she has watched every move. So when Nathan becomes the latest to stand in for Jared, she lets the game continue until the wedding, where she makes her final switch.
The Wrong Boyfriend, the Right Husband
The “Useless” Daughter-in-Law Was Their Last Hope
The “Useless” Daughter-in-Law Was Their Last HopeElite FamiliesThe Whitmores think Olivia is nothing more than a spoiled daughter-in-law, always spending her husband’s money on luxury bags. But when a ruthless businessman uses three gold mines as leverage to seize the family company, they still try to push her aside. They should have known better. Olivia notices a counterfeit watch, exposes the fake documents, and reveals the truth everyone missed—the gold mines belong to her.
The “Useless” Daughter-in-Law Was Their Last Hope
They’ll Eat Dirt When I Strike
They’ll Eat Dirt When I StrikeModernPaige has been betrayed, but she refuses to stay broken. She turns to revenge in the middle of mafia power battles, reclaiming her pride one step at a time until a powerful protector enters her life. Twists keep coming, and so does the chemistry.
They’ll Eat Dirt When I Strike
The Mafia Don Bears Every Pain I Suffer
The Mafia Don Bears Every Pain I SufferModernThe moment Mara steps back into the wealthy family she was born into, she discovers a terrifying secret: she no longer feels pain, because every wound is being suffered by Adrian, the city’s most feared mafia don. Betrayed and made the family’s scapegoat, she decides she’s done enduring their cruelty in silence. But Adrian keeps tracing the pain back to her, and the truth between them may be far more dangerous than either of them expects.
The Mafia Don Bears Every Pain I Suffer

Tycoon Life 💰

My Ex Dumped Me, So I Married the Mafia Don
My Ex Dumped Me, So I Married the Mafia DonModernCast out by Camille and left with nothing, Gabriel agrees to a contract marriage with mafia godmother Valentina for one reason: to help traumatized Nico heal. In the process, he rebuilds himself, turns down Camille’s reconciliation, and comes to love Valentina for real as he protects the family they’ve formed.
My Ex Dumped Me, So I Married the Mafia Don
They Humiliated Me Like a Beggar—So I Took Back the Entire Block
They Humiliated Me Like a Beggar—So I Took Back the Entire BlockModernMocked as a nobody and publicly humiliated, Hayes let them believe he was beneath them. But the man they insulted is the billionaire landlord behind the entire block. After ten years of supporting their businesses, he watches them refuse their agreements and cross the line. No more free meals, no more favors—just eviction notices and a ruthless takeback of everything they took for granted.
They Humiliated Me Like a Beggar—So I Took Back the Entire Block
Born a Sinclair, Raised a Romano
Born a Sinclair, Raised a RomanoModernAdrian returns to the billionaire home that should have been his, only to discover someone else living the life meant for him. His family demands gratitude and obedience, but he was raised by a Mafia dynasty, not by people who taught him to plead. Inside the mansion, polished smiles and quiet tension hide deeper intentions. Everyone believes power is already settled—yet the rejected son is the only one who doesn’t seem afraid.
Born a Sinclair, Raised a Romano
Beggar Don's Back: Touch My Daughter, Die
Beggar Don's Back: Touch My Daughter, DieModernOn the day Dante Falcone was meant to be married, one call dragged the Falcone Family Don into a deadly clash at Brooklyn Harbor. The explosion took him from view, and the world was left to believe he had died.
Beggar Don's Back: Touch My Daughter, Die
Dumped by My Wife, Chosen by the Mafia Queen
Dumped by My Wife, Chosen by the Mafia QueenModernNoah, a gifted magician, is left behind by the woman he once loved. He then ties his fate to Serena, a mafia boss, through a contract marriage. As he helps traumatized Leo recover with magic, Noah also starts to heal from his own past. Protected by Serena from his ex-wife, he finds that the marriage of convenience is becoming something far more real.
Dumped by My Wife, Chosen by the Mafia Queen
Hidden Legend Captain
Hidden Legend CaptainModernEthan Cole’s first day on the job turns into a nightmare when he detects a hidden defect in Flight SA892 and tries to halt its departure. Dismissed as a stalker by captain Madison Reed and shut down by those above him, his urgent warnings go unheard. As the situation spirals toward catastrophe, Ethan must trust his sharp instincts to steer the crippled plane through impossible danger and save everyone aboard.
Hidden Legend Captain
XXL Husband, Crowned in Black Gold
XXL Husband, Crowned in Black Gold ModernCast aside after years of childlessness and cruel mockery over his body, Elian is driven out by his ex-wife’s family. He then enters a marriage with Sabina, the feared mafia queen who embraces him without hesitation. When she becomes pregnant, Elian learns the truth he was never meant to see—his infertility was part of a deception that had been planned for years.
XXL Husband, Crowned in Black Gold
The Mafia Queen’s Hellraiser Husband
The Mafia Queen’s Hellraiser HusbandModernWhat begins as an unexpected union between Aurelio Vitale and Adriana DeMarco soon gives Aurelio a place where he truly belongs. Through his growing connection with Sofia and Leo, he becomes a devoted father figure, while his bond with Adriana is strengthened by trust and shared duty. Together, they create a family rooted in affection, courage, and lasting unity.
The Mafia Queen’s Hellraiser Husband
Humiliated by Agent, I Stun Her With True Identity
Humiliated by Agent, I Stun Her With True IdentityModernHe came to view an apartment dressed like any ordinary old man, and was humiliated at every turn—his documents stomped on, his dignity smashed, the police summoned. Even his son, arriving in a construction jacket, was attacked. Then the truth hits hard: the executives rush in and bow to him as “Mr. Reed,” because he owns the building. With surveillance recording everything and hidden money suddenly exposed, those who mocked him are left blacklisted. Never judge the man in the faded shirt.
Humiliated by Agent, I Stun Her With True Identity
The Billionaire's Wild Son
The Billionaire's Wild SonModernSent back to the Blackwood family after growing up in Villain Valley, true heir Ryder must face a home full of bias and tricks. Julian keeps challenging him as the fake heir, but Ryder answers with strength, wilderness wisdom, and steady resolve. From equestrian competitions to school exams, he keeps beating the odds—and the wager with Julian becomes his chance to take back what is rightfully his.
The Billionaire's Wild Son
Betrayed by Blood, Backed by Billions
Betrayed by Blood, Backed by BillionsModernA Montana cowboy named Colt is suddenly claimed by an elite New York family as their true heir. But with Julian sabotaging him at every turn and Sloane publicly casting him off, Colt is forced to take the insults in front of everyone. When he calls his foster dad during a grand gala, the crowd laughs—until they learn the man behind the call is the hidden king of the West. Panic spreads through the room, Colt exposes Julian's lies, rejects Sloane's late regret, and returns to the life he came from.
Betrayed by Blood, Backed by Billions
[Dubbed]You Should've Been Nicer
[Dubbed]You Should've Been NicerModernDismissed and doubted, Lucas Bennett stayed hidden until the right moment. Then the heir they never expected stepped forward and took back power, justice, and the truth. Amid every lie and betrayal, she waited for this day. Now it has come—and his name will not be forgotten.
[Dubbed]You Should've Been Nicer
The Unkept Vow
The Unkept VowModernEthan Whitmore, heir to a New York old-money family, is struck by three crushing losses at once: a broken engagement, his father’s sudden death, and Vivian’s infidelity. He wipes away his identity and disappears. As guilt drives Vivian to take revenge on their rival and search for him relentlessly, fate brings them face to face in a cemetery three years later, where the reunion turns into burning tragedy. In the end, Ethan heads to a Pacific island to start over.
The Unkept Vow
The Billionaire Fiance Begging for a Dollar
The Billionaire Fiance Begging for a DollarModernTo uncover the girl he never forgot, billionaire Callum sheds his fortune and pretends to be homeless. Nora is pushed toward a corporate executive, yet her heart leads her back to him despite her family’s insults. A tiny toy ring becomes the thread to a ten-year promise and a hidden truth.
The Billionaire Fiance Begging for a Dollar
The Mafia King's Adopted Son Bows to No One
The Mafia King's Adopted Son Bows to No OneModernDario has been hunted down by a mafia family, only to be ridiculed by a false heir and publicly abandoned by the woman he was meant to marry. But one call is enough to strike back and wreck her family’s business. When the Rosanos realize the so-called "street dog" from Corleone is protected by people even they fear, it’s too late. The true heir is done pretending—tonight, he takes everything.
The Mafia King's Adopted Son Bows to No One
Cross The Don’s Heir, Face Ruin
Cross The Don’s Heir, Face RuinModernAs the hidden heir to a family that decides who holds power, he’s expected to stay invisible. But when his arranged fiancée lets her childhood sweetheart mock and humiliate him in front of everyone, while she simply stands by laughing, she makes one fatal mistake. She thinks he’s beneath her. One call is enough to remind the room who really commands respect. Now the only question is how far her father will go when he learns what that “love” has cost his family.
Cross The Don’s Heir, Face Ruin
She hired a beggar got a Mafia Don
She hired a beggar got a Mafia DonModernEvan Reed, California’s feared Mafia Don, hides his identity by dressing as a beggar and setting out to measure human kindness. Chloe is the one who slips him $100, then brings him home as her fake boyfriend for her mother’s birthday. There, her family, his ex, and an arrogant wealthy rival mock the man they assume is worthless, blind to the fact that Evan quietly funded the success they brag about. But a million-dollar present and an armored convoy are ready to uncover the Black Wolf’s true power. When the truth comes out, will his secret empire silence the room—and could this hired romance turn into something real?
She hired a beggar got a Mafia Don
My Ex Dumped Me, Then I Married The Mafia Queen
My Ex Dumped Me, Then I Married The Mafia QueenModernOnce dismissed in favor of a mafia enforcer, Adrian returns three years later with a status no one expected—at the side of the dreaded Ferretti Mafia Queen as her husband. Yet when his ex fails to recognize him, she treats him like a nobody and commands him to wait on her new family.
My Ex Dumped Me, Then I Married The Mafia Queen
My Stepfather Is Mad Dog
My Stepfather Is Mad DogModernDario Falcone has a name that makes New York step back: the infamous “Mad Dog.” Sent to marry mafia Donna Serafina Valenti, he expects tension, not tenderness. Then he meets Sofia and Luca, her two neglected children. When little Luca timidly calls him “Dad,” Dario’s world changes. From that moment on, anyone who targets the children must face him. He arrived ready to be feared, but ends up becoming the protector—and father—they were waiting for.
My Stepfather Is Mad Dog
Underworld King’s Return
Underworld King’s ReturnModernFor a decade, Kane kept his past buried and lived as a mechanic, hoping to protect the daughter he raised in peace. But the moment Nina uncovers her fiancé’s secret arms deal, everything spirals into chaos. The man everyone overlooks is the same one the underworld once feared most, and now he’s coming for anyone involved. Gangsters, a corrupt deputy mayor, and a deadly $800 million bounty all close in on the city. As killers gather, Kane will stop at nothing to find his daughter and bring her home.
Underworld King’s Return
Ithaca ：The Legend of the Nameless One
Ithaca ：The Legend of the Nameless OneSupernaturalOnce rejected by the twelve Olympians at the rite that should have marked his rise, Nicandros vanished from Ithaca. A decade later, he comes back hardened by three masters and driven by one goal: to find his mother. But the Trial of Clans pulls him into a brutal reckoning, where he defeats a Cyclops barehanded, shatters Apollo’s sacred bow, and reveals strange gray-gold marks tied to a hidden power. Scorned by his brother and mistrusted by his own clan, he must rise above exile and prove he can decide his own destiny.
Ithaca ：The Legend of the Nameless One
My Curse, My Fortune
My Curse, My FortuneModernMatteo’s gift lets him see ghosts, but his family only ever sees him as a burden, while Julian lives as their favored son. After Veronica Mendoza slips into a coma, Matteo agrees to look after her when her ghost promises him $20 million. Julian moves to claim the praise, yet Veronica wakes up remembering everything. With the truth finally out, Matteo and Veronica turn the tables on those who lied and betrayed them.
My Curse, My Fortune
Super-firefighter
Super-firefighterModernOne electric shock changes everything for firefighter Zane: he gains pyrokinesis, x-ray vision, and teleportation. From there, he steps into Veronica Winters’ life as a contract fiancé, shuts down C4 bombing schemes and dark web assassins, and takes down the ruthless Cassius Slater. Even his estranged father, Cole Slater, is terrified enough to mistake him for a “national-level secret boss,” while Zane rises higher with his sweet wife by his side.
Super-firefighter
My son-in-law is a big spender
My son-in-law is a big spenderModernEvan Reed, the dreaded Black Wolf of the mafia world, goes undercover as a beggar to test the people around him. Chloe is the one who shows him kindness, giving him money and later bringing him home as a fake boyfriend for her mother’s birthday celebration. Her proud family looks down on him, her sister is busy cheating, and her arrogant suitor keeps pushing his luck—but Evan stays in character until the truth can no longer be hidden. From lavish gifts to a luxury motorcade and the power of the Obsidian empire, the beggar they dismissed turns out to be the man they fear, and Chloe’s arranged romance turns real.
My son-in-law is a big spender
You Called Me a Freeloader? I Own This Market.
You Called Me a Freeloader? I Own This Market.ModernThey called Cole Kennard a parasite and destroyed their long-term lease at Northbridge Market, unaware that the market existed because of him. Once the truth comes out, Cole repossesses every stall and rebuilds the site as a luxury complex, leaving the ungrateful vendors to deal with serious legal consequences.
You Called Me a Freeloader? I Own This Market.
Farm Boy? Billionaire!
